_note: Intent catalog. `type` (public/protected) is fixed here — the classifier never decides whether identity is needed. `kind`: answer = handler + reply; action = write that needs confirmation; escalate = always hand to a human; decline = out of scope. `requires` lists the CommercePort capabilities an intent needs; if the company's adapter lacks one, the agent hands the request to a human instead of attempting it.

intents.name: size_advice
intents.label: Size help
intents.description: Which size or width to buy in a {{BRAND_NAME}} product, size conversions (US/UK/EU/cm), fit questions.

intents.name: product_question
intents.label: Product info
intents.description: Questions about a product's materials, features, care, comfort, waterproofing, price or colors.

intents.name: stock_check
intents.label: Check stock
intents.description: Whether a product is in stock in a size/width/color, or when it will be restocked.

intents.name: shipping_policy
intents.label: Shipping & returns policy
intents.description: General shipping costs, delivery times, where we ship, and the general return/exchange/refund/warranty policy (not about a specific order).

intents.name: store_info
intents.label: Find a store
intents.description: Store locations, opening hours, in-store try-on.

intents.name: discount_code
intents.label: Discount code
intents.description: Whether a specific discount code is valid or why it isn't working.

intents.name: track_order
intents.label: Track my order
intents.description: Status, tracking or delivery date of the customer's own order.

intents.name: refund_status
intents.label: Refund status
intents.description: Status or timing of a refund for the customer's own order or return.

intents.name: return_request
intents.label: Return an item
intents.description: The customer wants to send an item back for a refund.

intents.name: exchange_request
intents.label: Exchange an item
intents.description: The customer wants to swap an item for a different size, width or color.

intents.name: cancel_or_modify_order
intents.label: Cancel or change an order
intents.description: Cancel an order, or change its address or items.

intents.name: warranty_claim
intents.label: Faulty product
intents.description: A product is defective or broke (e.g. sole came off, stitching failed).

intents.name: human_handoff
intents.label: Talk to a person
intents.description: The customer asks for a human, agent, or person.

intents.name: safety_or_legal
intents.label: Safety or legal
intents.description: Injury, allergic reaction, product safety issue, legal threats, chargebacks, regulatory complaints.

intents.name: out_of_scope
intents.label: Other
intents.description: Anything unrelated to {{BRAND_NAME}} shoes, orders or stores (homework, coding, general chat, politics, other companies).
